name: Vein
author: E. T. Carter
description: Only the seams of a voronoi partition — thin capillary lines on a near-black field that continuously rewire: edges fade in along their length, dock into junctions with a soft glint, stand a while, then thin and retract, each seam tinted by its two neighbouring cells.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: Diameter of the cells whose boundaries form the network; small cells give a dense capillary mesh, large cells a sparse arterial map.

params.label: Rewire rate
params.effect: How quickly edges grow in and retract — from slow lichen-paced turnover to a web visibly knitting itself.

params.label: Coverage
params.effect: Fraction of the network standing at any moment; low values leave sparse exploring threads, high values an almost-complete web with rare gaps.

params.label: Vein width
params.effect: Thickness of the capillary lines in CSS pixels; hairline veins recede into the dark, thick veins make the graph the subject.
